cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Win the Smaller Concession
cards.instruction: Get one small surrender, then use its logic to make the larger claim harder to defend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me put this little plant on your windowsill. It only needs a corner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One small plant won't block the light.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. That gives us the rule. I'll put the second one beside it; they're both below the glass.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said the light was the problem. Stand back and check it from there; if both fit below the glass, I'll keep them together.

reason: Use B stated light reason as the logic A claims governs permission, then direct a practical visibility test to undermine the numerical limit.
